Apple TV (now $6.99/month for Black Friday) just added a new original movie: Way of the Warrior Kid starring Chris Pratt. The streamer also has a new batch of beloved classic films coming next week.

Way of the Warrior Kid is new movie on Apple TV starring Chris Pratt and Linda Cardellini

Apple Original Films has a new movie out today, available exclusively for Apple TV subscribers.

Way of the Warrior Kid stars Chris Pratt, Linda Cardellini, and Jude Hill and is directed by McG (“Charlie’s Angels,” “Terminator Salvation”).

The film is based on the novel of the same name by bestselling author and retired Navy SEAL Jocko Willink, who also stars.

Here’s the plot summary followed by the trailer:

Middle school has been a nightmare for Marc (Hill), a good kid who’s bullied by his classmates and feels like he’s behind in everything, from academics to P.E. to just making friends. That changes when his injured Uncle Jake (Pratt), a decorated Navy SEAL, comes to spend the summer and recuperate with Marc and his mom, Sarah (Cardellini). To help Marc defend himself, Jake devises an ambitious program he calls “Operation Warrior Kid” based on his SEAL training. Instead of teaching his nephew how to fight, Jake shows Marc what real courage is, facing down his own demons along the way.

You can watch Way of the Warrior Kid here on Apple TV.

Other recent originals from Apple include award contenders Being Heumann, from the director of Best Picture winner CODA, and the acclaimed Tenzing.

Upcoming movies on Apple TV

Apple TV recently started adding large batches of beloved classic movies to its catalog, in addition to its slate of originals.

Now available for subscribers are fan-favorites like Interstellar, Minority Report, Pulp Fiction, Talladega Nights, and more.

Coming next Tuesday, December 1 is a fresh batch that includes:

  • Shutter Island, the Martin Scorsese film with Leonardo DiCaprio
  • Friends with Benefits, starring Justin Timberlake and Mila Kunis
  • Magnolia, from director Paul Thomas Anderson
  • Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery, the Mike Myers comedy
  • The Karate Kid, the 1984 classic

Apple normally adds 15-20 movies every month, so the five titles above are likely just a fraction of what’s coming.

Apple TV is available for just $6.99/ month (over 50% off) for Black Friday.
